en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a picturesque rural landscape with mountains in the background and a church with a prominent steeple in the foreground. The scene is pastoral, with fields, trees, and small buildings scattered across the valley. The text 'Feistritz an der Gail' is clearly visible at the bottom of the postcard, along with the number '6528' on the lower right.
